sdk.role: MetricsSnapshot.max_budget_per_task defaults None; snapshots/merge preserve existing values only.
LLM metrics are PrivateAttr and not configuration fields.

restore_metrics seeds already-existing persisted metrics, not a budget setting.

agentServer.role: Constructs LocalConversation without forwarding a budget.
Emits authoritative state.stats as stats updates.

limits: No frontend store/event injection, metrics mutation or persistence edits were used.

evidenceType: Draft source-contract trace and actual supported-runtime gate; no rendered positive-cap meter.
